task: Estimate the specified Parkinson disease symptom score from biomedical voice measurements.
context: Jitter fields measure fundamental-frequency variation; Shimmer fields measure amplitude variation; NHR and HNR measure noise relative to tonal components; RPDE, DFA and PPE are nonlinear voice descriptors. Values retain their supplied scales. Targets are the source clinician scores linearly interpolated over time. Patient ID, demographics, elapsed time and the other symptom score are not provided.
